questions.prompt: Which Git command initializes a new repository in the current directory?
questions.explanation: git init creates a .git folder, turning the directory into a Git repository.

questions.prompt: Which command stages all modified and new files for the next commit?
questions.explanation: git add . stages all changes in the current directory.

questions.prompt: After creating a branch 'feature', what command merges it into 'main'?
questions.explanation: git merge feature incorporates the feature branch into the current branch.
